H5500.def: a primitive root; to sweep away:--scrape.

H5502.def: a primitive root; to scrape off:--sweep (away).

H5503.def: a primitive root; to travel round (specifically as a pedlar); intensively, to palpitate:--go about, merchant(-man), occupy with, pant, trade, traffick.

H5505.def: from «05503»; an emporium; abstractly, profit (from trade):--mart, merchandise.

H5507.def: properly, active participle feminine of «05503»; something surrounding the person, i.e. a shield:--buckler.

H5508.def: similar to «05507»; probably a (black) tile (or tessara) for laying borders with:--black marble.

H5509.et: from (05472) in the sense of refuse
H5509.def: or cuwg (Ezek. 22:18) {soog}; from «05472» in the sense of refuse; scoria:--dross.

H5510.def: probably of Persian origin; Sivan, the third Heb. month:--Sivan.

H5511.def: or Ciychon {see-khone'}; from the same as «05477»; tempestuous; Sichon, an Amoritish king:--Sihon.

H5512.def: of uncertain derivation; Sin the name of an Egyptian town and (probably) desert adjoining:--Sin.

H5513.et: from an otherwise unknown name of a man
H5513.def: from an otherwise unknown name of a man; a Sinite, or descendant of one of the sons of Canaan:--Sinite.

H5514.def: of uncertain derivation; Sinai, mountain of Arabia:--Sinai.

H5515.def: plural of an otherwise unknown name; Sinim, a distant Oriental region:--Sinim.

H5516.def: of uncertain derivation; Sisera, the name of a Canaanitish king and of one of the Nethinim:--Sisera.

H5517.et: from an unused root meaning to converse
H5517.def: or Ciyeahai {see-ah-haw'}; from an unused root meaning to converse; congregation; Sia or Siaha, one of the Nethinim:-- Sia, Siaha.

H5518.et: from a primitive root meaning to boil up
H5518.def: or (feminine) ciyrah {see-raw'}; or cirah (Jeremiah 52:18) {see-raw'}; from a primitive root meaning to boil up; a pot; also a thorn (as springing up rapidly); by implication, a hook:--caldron, fishhook, pan, ((wash-))pot, thorn.

H5519.def: from «05526»; properly, a thicket of men, i.e. a crowd:-- multitude.

H5520.def: from «05526»; a hut (as of entwined boughs); also a lair:-- covert, den, pavilion, tabernacle.

H5521.def: fem of «05520»; a hut or lair:--booth, cottage, covert, pavilion, tabernacle, tent.

H5523.def: or Cukkoth {sook-kohth'}; plural of «05521»; booths; Succoth, the name of a place in Egypt and of three in Palestine:-- Succoth.

H5524.def: from «05523» and the (irreg.) plural of «01323»; booths of (the) daughters; brothels, i.e. idoalatrous tents for impure purpose:--Succoth-benoth.

H5525.def: patrial from an unknown name (perhaps «05520»); a Sukkite, or inhabitant of some place near Egypt (i.e. hut-dwellers):-- Sukkiims.

H5526.def: or sakak (Exod. 33:22) {saw-kak'}; a primitive root; properly, to entwine as a screen; by implication, to fence in, cover over, (figuratively) protect:--cover, defence, defend, hedge in, join together, set, shut up.

H5527.def: from «05526»; inclosure; Secacah, a place in Palestine:--Secacah.

H5528.def: for «03688»; to be silly:--do (make, play the, turn into) fool(-ish, -ishly, -ishness).

H5529.def: from «05528»; silliness; concretely and collectively, dolts:--folly.

H5532.def: a primitive root; to be familiar with; by implication, to minister to, be serviceable to, be customary:--acquaint (self), be advantage, × ever, (be, (un-))profit(-able), treasurer, be wont.

H5533.def: probably a denominative from «07915»; properly, to cut, i.e. damage; also to grow (causatively, make) poor:--endanger, impoverish.

H5534.def: a primitive root; to shut up; by implication, to surrender:--stop, give over. See also «05462», «07936».

H5535.et: a primitive root to be silent
H5535.def: a primitive root to be silent; by implication, to observe quietly:--take heed.

H5536.def: from «05549»; properly, a willow twig (as pendulous), i.e. an osier; but only as woven into a basket:--basket.

H5537.def: a primitive root; to suspend in a balance, i.e. weigh:--compare.

H5538.def: from «05549»; an embankment; Silla, a place in Jerusalem:--Silla.

H5539.def: a primitive root; probably to leap (with joy), i.e. exult:--harden self.

H5541.def: a primitive root; to hang up, i.e. weigh, or (figuratively) contemn:--tread down (under foot), value.

H5543.def: or Calluw; {sal-loo'}; or Caluw {sal-loo'}; or Callay {sal-lah'-ee}; from «05541»; weighed; Sallu or Sallai, the name of two Israelites:--Sallai, Sallu, Salu.

H5544.def: or callown {sal-one'}; from «05541»; a prickle (as if pendulous); brier, thorn.

H5545.def: a primitive root; to forgive:--forgive, pardon, spare.

H5548.et: from an unused root meaning to walk
H5548.def: from an unused root. meaning to walk; walking; Salcah, a place East of the Jordan:--Salcah, Salchah.

H5549.def: a primitive root; to mound up (especially a turnpike); figurative, to exalt; reflexively, to oppose (as by a dam):-- cast up, exalt (self), extol, make plain, raise up.

H5550.def: or cowllah {so-lel-aw'}; active participle feminine of «05549», but used passively; a military mound, i.e. rampart of besiegers:--bank, mount.

H5553.et: from an unused root meaning to be lofty
H5553.def: from an unused root meaning to be lofty; a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress):--(ragged) rock, stone(-ny), strong hold.

H5554.def: the same as «05553»; Sela, the rock-city of Idumaea:--rock, Sela(-h).

H5555.et: from (05553) and the pl. of (04256) with the article interposed
H5555.def: from «05553» and the plural of «04256» with the article interposed; rock of the divisions; Sela- ham-Machlekoth, a place in Palestine:--Sela-hammalekoth.

H5556.et: apparently from the same as (05553) in the sense of crushing as with a rock, i.e. consuming
H5556.def: apparently from the same as «05553» in the sense of crushing as with a rock, i.e. consuming; a kind of locust (from its destructiveness):--bald locust.

H5557.def: a primitive root; properly, to wrench, i.e. (figuratively) to subvert:--overthrow, pervert.

H5560.et: from an unused root meaning to strip
H5560.def: from an unused root meaning to strip; flour (as chipped off):--(fine) flour, meal.

H5561.et: from an unused root meaning to smell sweet
H5561.def: from an unused root meaning to smell sweet; an aroma:-- sweet (spice).

H5562.def: of foreign origin; Samgar-Nebo, a Babylonian general:--Samgar-nebo.

H5563.def: of uncertain derivation; a vine blossom; used also adverbially, abloom:--tender grape.

H5564.def: a primitive root; to prop (literally or figuratively); reflexively, to lean upon or take hold of (in a favorable or unfavorable sense):--bear up, establish, (up-)hold, lay, lean, lie hard, put, rest self, set self, stand fast, stay (self), sustain.

H5565.def: from «05564» and «03050»; supported of Jah; Semakjah, an Israelite:--Semachiah.

H5566.et: from an unused root meaning to resemble
H5566.def: or cemel {say'-mel}; from an unused root meaning to resemble; a likeness:--figure, idol, image.

H5568.def: a primitive root; to be erect, i.e. bristle as hair:--stand up, tremble.

H5570.et: from an unused root meaning to prick
H5570.def: from an unused root meaning to prick; thorny; Senaah, a place in Palestine:--Senaah, Hassenaah (with the article).

H5571.def: of foreign origin; Sanballat, a Persian satrap of Samaria:--Sanballat.

H5572.et: from an unused root meaning to prick
H5572.def: from an unused root meaning to prick; a bramble:--bush.

H5573.def: the same s «05572»; thorn; Seneh, a crag in Palestine:--Seneh.

H5574.def: or Cnu.ah {sen-oo-aw'} from the same as «05570»; pointed; (used with the article as a proper name) Senuah, the name of two Israelites:--Hasenuah (including the art), Senuah.

H5576.def: of foreign origin; Sancherib, an Assyrian king:--Sennacherib.

H5577.et: from an unused root meaning to be pointed
H5577.def: from an unused root meaning to be pointed; a twig (as tapering):--bough.

H5578.def: feminine of a form of «05577»; a bough; Sansannah, a place in Palestine:--Sansannah.

H5580.def: from the same as «05483»; a moth (from the agility of the fly):--moth.

H5581.def: of uncertain derivation; Sismai, an Israelite:--Sisamai.

H5582.def: a primitive root; to suport (mostly figurative):--comfort, establish, hold up, refresh self, strengthen, be upholden.

H5585.def: from «05586»; a fissure (of rocks); also a bough (as subdivided):--(outmost) branch, clift, top.

H5586.def: a primitive root; properly, to divide up; but used only as denominative from «05585», to disbranch (a tree):--top.

H5587.def: or samiph {saw-eef'}; from «05586»; divided (in mind), i.e. (abstractly) a sentiment:--opinion.

H5588.def: from «05586»; divided (in mind), i.e. (concretely) a skeptic:--thought.

H5589.def: feminine of «05585»; a twig:--bough, branch. Compare «05634».

H5590.def: a primitive root; to rush upon; by implication, to toss (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative):--be (toss with) tempest(-uous), be sore, troubled, come out as a (drive with the, scatter with a) whirlwind.

H5591.def: or (feminine) ctarah {seh-aw-raw'}; from «05590»; a hurricane:--storm(-y), tempest, whirlwind.

H5592.et: from (05605), in its original sense of containing
H5592.def: from «05605», in its original sense of containing; a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine):--bason, bowl, cup, door (post), gate, post, threshold.

H5593.def: the same as «05592»; Saph, a Philistine:--Saph. Compare «05598».

H5594.def: a primitive root; properly, to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication, to wail:--lament, mourn(-er), wail.

H5595.def: a primitive root; properly, to scrape (literally, to shave; but usually figuratively) together (i.e. to accumulate or increase) or away (i.e. to scatter, remove, or ruin; intransitively, to perish):--add, augment, consume, destroy, heap, join, perish, put.

H5596.def: or saphach (Isaiah 3:17) {saw-fakh'}; a primitive root; properly, to scrape out, but in certain peculiar senses (of removal or association):--abiding, gather together, cleave, smite with the scab.

H5597.def: from «05596»; the mange (as making the hair fall off):--scab.

H5598.def: from «05592»; bason-like; Sippai, a Philistine:--Sippai. Compare «05593».

H5599.def: from «05596»; something (spontaneously) falling off, i.e. a self-sown crop; figuratively, a freshet:--(such) things as (which) grow (of themselves), which groweth of its own accord (itself).
